en-US.description: Optional gitsign helper that caches signing credentials in memory
en-US.longDescription: gitsign-credential-cache is an optional helper binary for gitsign that caches ephemeral private keys and Fulcio signing certificates in memory over a local socket, so back-to-back signing operations do not need to repeat the OIDC authentication flow.
en-US.name: gitsign-credential-cache

zh-CN.description: gitsign 的可选辅助工具，可在内存中缓存签名凭据
zh-CN.longDescription: gitsign-credential-cache 是 gitsign 的可选辅助二进制程序，通过本地套接字将临时私钥和 Fulcio 签名证书缓存在内存中，使连续的签名操作无需重复 OIDC 身份验证流程。
